summary: Discussing the first global conflict that this unit is named after, Topic 7.2 covers the causes of World War 1, summarized by the acronym MAIN. Within a hotbed of militarism, alliances, imperialism, and nationalism, disaster is the only outcome of an Archduke’s assassintion.
